subject: Invoice ingest handshake, ACK token format, and exception paths
messages:

Cc: vendor-support@brightpeak.com

Subject: Onboarding — invoice submission handshake

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for walking us through onboarding last week. We have two quick follow-ups from BrightPeak finance before we flip the switch:

1) Can you confirm the exact subject-line tokens Redwood will inspect to route invoices automatically (we currently stamp PO numbers in the subject)?
2) What does your ACK response look like when an invoice fails line-item validation vs a total-mismatch? BrightPeak needs to map those to our retry logic.

I attached a small CSV with our typical invoice rows (brightpeak_sample_invoice.csv). Happy to hop on a call if that's easier.

Best,
Sam Taylor
Procurement Operations — BrightPeak Inc.

From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Onboarding — invoice submission handshake

Hi Sam — thanks for the CSV, it helped clarify a couple of edge cases. High level answers below; I also pasted a proposed minimal ACK spec at the bottom.

Routing / subject tokens
- We prefer PO in subject as: "PO: <PO_NUMBER>" or "PO#<PO_NUMBER>". If no PO is present we fall back to parsing the first attachment for a matching PO line.
- If multiple PO numbers appear we route to "multi-po" queue and flag for manual review (this is rare but we want to avoid mis-posting).

ACK semantics
- 200-ACK: accepted and queued for processing (includes idempotency token).
- 422-ACK: schema/line-item rejection (includes one or more rejection codes and line indexes).
- 409-ACK: duplicate or PO mismatch (includes reference to existing invoice id).
- 500-ACK: transient processing error (retry window: 15 minutes, 3 attempts).

I'm looping Marissa to confirm the subject examples we should publish in the vendor guide and Kim to confirm how this maps to AP's PO-stamping policy.

Proposed minimal ACK payload (see attached ack-token-spec.md) — short form:
- ack_id: <string>
- status: [accepted|rejected|duplicate|error]
- reject_reasons: ["LINE_MISMATCH", "TOTAL_MISMATCH", "MISSING_PO"] (if applicable)
- details_url: https://redwood-inference.ops/invoice/ack/<ack_id>

Happy to make the ACK more human-readable if BrightPeak needs it.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Partner Onboarding — Redwood Inference

FWIW — two operational notes from AP:

- PO stamping: AP requires the PO to be present on invoice header or a clearly mapped line (we can't accept ambiguous PO refs). If BrightPeak intends to include multiple POs on a single invoice, we need an explicit "PO_SPLIT" flag in the CSV to avoid manual splits.
- Exception queue SLA: if an invoice lands in manual review due to ambiguous routing, ops will triage within 4 business hours for standard vendors, 2 hours for priority partners.

Marissa
Director, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference

Thanks — that helps a lot. Two follow-ups:

1) For 422-ACK (LINE_MISMATCH), what is the expected resolution path? Does BrightPeak re-post a corrected invoice to a dedicated retry endpoint or reply to the original email?
2) For duplicate detection (409-ACK), do you include the original invoice upload timestamp in the ACK payload so we can confirm whether our system actually re-sent due to an upstream failure?

We prefer to re-post corrected invoices to a retry endpoint rather than reply-to-email. If you support an authenticated retry URL in the ACK payload (short TTL), that's ideal.

—Sam

Hi Sam / Aisha — quick operational clarifications from AP (cc'd):

- Retry endpoint: we have an authenticated retry URL pattern we can surface in the 422-ACK: https://ingest.redwood.com/retry/<short_token>. Short_token TTL defaults to 30 minutes (configurable per vendor).
- Duplicate payload: ACK will include original_upload_ts and system_invoice_id for 409s. That should make reconciliation painless.
- Multi-PO invoices: if BrightPeak must send a single file with multiple POs, include a header column "PO_SPLIT=TRUE" and a per-line PO column; AP will split programmatically, but it still counts as one submission for SLA.

I'll update the onboarding guide with these examples. Aisha — can you include a short example subject line block we can publish to vendors?

Kimberly Park
Manager, Accounts Payable — Redwood Inference

Sam — attaching the short vendor-friendly subject examples below and the ACK spec we discussed. Please confirm if BrightPeak wants the retry TTL extended to 2 hours (we can do that for enterprise partners).

Suggested subject line examples (publishable in vendor guide):
- "Invoice — PO: PO123456 — BrightPeak"
- "Invoice PO#PO123456 | BrightPeak Inc. | 20260801"
- "Invoice — Multiple POs: PO123456, PO123457 (PO_SPLIT=TRUE)"

Short ACK example (human-friendly):
- ack_id: rgw-ack-0001
- status: rejected
- reject_reasons: [LINE_MISMATCH]
- details_url: https://redwood-inference.ops/invoice/ack/rgw-ack-0001
- retry_url: https://ingest.redwood.com/retry/abc123 (TTL: 30m)

Jordan — per your earlier ask, this also maps to the vendor enrollment form: we will add a checkbox for "I will send PO in subject / or attach PO file" and an optional field for desired retry TTL.

Thanks all — Sam, once BrightPeak confirms TTL preferences we'll publish a concise PDF and flip the integration live.

—Aisha
Partner Onboarding — Redwood Inference
